children: US neurological diagnostics firm's Q3 revenue rose 30% yr/yr, slightly beating analyst expectations
Q3 loss per share widened and missed analyst expectations
Growth driven by record new customer additions and higher utilization
Ceribell raises 2026 revenue guidance to $115 mln-$117 mln
Company says 2026 outlook excludes material contributions from neonate, pediatric and delirium products
Ceribell says delirium launch and upcoming hardware platform position company for pivotal 2027
SAME-STORE GROWTH - Co said revenue growth was driven by higher utilization within existing accounts and increased adoption of its system
COST REDUCTIONS - Co said higher gross margin was due to manufacturing cost reduction initiatives and a new manufacturing line in Vietnam
HIGHER OPERATING EXPENSES - Commercial, R&D, stock-compensation and legal investments increased operating expenses 36% to $46.9 mln
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 8 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the advanced medical equipment & technology peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for CeriBell, Inc. is $30.00, about 11.3% above its November 2 closing price of $26.96
